variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the period loads, the tiles, the chart, the bar list and both tables render their own Skeleton, and Open by severity holds Skeleton rows, so nothing reflows when data arrives.

variants.name: Empty
variants.summary: A period with no alerts. The tiles show a dash with no delta, and every region keeps its box with an EmptyState that says why it is empty and what to do next.
